uClosed.description:
NYI: uClosed and vClosed define whether or not the specific dimension is to be evaluated as a closed surface
along the u and v directions, respectively.

vClosed.description:
NYI: uClosed and vClosed define whether or not the specific dimension is to be evaluated as a closed surface
along the u and v directions, respectively.

texCoord.description:
texCoord provides additional information on how to generate texture coordinates.
By default, texture coordinates in the unit square (or cube for 3D coordinates) are generated automatically
from the parametric subdivision. A NurbsTextureCoordinate node or simply a TextureCoordinate node can then
be used to compute a texture coordinate given a u/v parameter of the X3DParametricGeometryNode.
The NurbsTextureCoordinate also supports non-animated surfaces to specify a "chord length"-based texture coordinate parametrization.

X3DParametricGeometryNode.description:
The X3DParametricGeometryNode abstract node type is the base type for all geometry node types
that are created parametrically and use control points to describe the final shape of the surface. How the
control points are described and interpreted shall be a property of the individual node type.

X3DPointingDeviceSensorNode.description: An abstract base class for all pointing device sensor nodes.

X3DSensorNode.description: This abstract node type is the base type for all sensors.

enabled.description: Specifies whether this sensor is enabled. A disabled sensor does not produce any output.

X3DSequencerNode.description: The abstract node X3DSequencerNode forms the basis for all types of sequencers.

next.description:
If the next inputOnly field receives an SFBool event with value TRUE, it triggers the next output value in keyValue array by issuing a value_changed event with that value.
After reaching the boundary of keyValue array, next goes to the initial element after last.

previous.description:
If the previous inputOnly field receives an SFBool event with value TRUE, it triggers the previous output value in keyValue array by issuing a value_changed event with that value.
After reaching the boundary of keyValue array previous goes to the last element after the first.

key.description:
The key field contains the list of key times, the keyValue field contains values for the target field, one complete set of values for each key.
Sequencer nodes containing no keys in the key field shall not produce any events.
However, an input event that replaces an empty key field with one that contains keys will cause the sequencer node to produce events the next time that a set_fraction event is received.

set_fraction.description: The set_fraction inputOnly field receives an SFFloat event and causes the sequencer node function to evaluate, resulting in a value_changed output event of the specified type with the same timestamp as the set_fraction event.

X3DShaderNode.description: This abstract node type is the base type for all node types that specify a programmable shader.

language.description:
The language field is used to indicate to the browser which shading language is used for the source
 file(s). This field may be used as a hint for the browser if the shading language is not immediately
 determinable from the source (e.g., a generic MIME type of text/plain is returned). A browser may use
 this field for determining which node instance will be selected and to ignore languages that it is not
 capable of supporting. Three basic language types are defined for this specification and others may be
 optionally supported by a browser.

X3DShapeNode.description: This is the base node type for all Shape nodes.

isPickable.description: Defines whether the shape is pickable.

idOffset.description: Holds the id offset for VertexID picking.

X3DSoundNode.description: This abstract node type is the base for all sound nodes.

X3DSoundSourceNode.description: This abstract node type is used to derive node types that can emit audio data.

X3DSpatialGeometryNode.description: This is the abstract node for spatial geometry nodes.

X3DTexture3DNode.description: This abstract node type is the base type for all node types that specify 3D sources for texture images.

X3DTextureCoordinateNode.description: This abstract node type is the base type for all node types which specify texture coordinates.

X3DTextureNode.description: This abstract node type is the base type for all node types which specify sources for texture images.

origChannelCount.description: Specifies the channel count of the texture. 0 means the system should figure out the count automatically.

url.description: Sets the url to a resource.

repeatS.description: Specifies whether the texture is repeated in s direction.

repeatT.description: Specifies whether the texture is repeated in t direction.

scale.description: Specifies whether the texture is scaled to the next highest power of two. (Needed, when texture repeat is enabled and texture size is non power of two)

X3DTextureTransformNode.description: This abstract node type is the base type for all node types which specify a transformation of texture coordinates.

X3DTimeDependentNode.description: This abstract node type is the base node type from which all time-dependent nodes are derived.

loop.description: Specifies whether the timer cycle loops.

description.description: Description for intended purpose of the node.

X3DTouchSensorNode.description: An abstract base class for all sensors that process touch events.

X3DTransformNode.description: This abstract node type is the basis for all node types that group and transform their children.

X3DTriggerNode.description: This abstract node type is the base node type from which all trigger nodes are derived.

X3DVertexAttributeNode.description:
This abstract node type is the base type for all node types that specify per-vertex attribute
information to the shader.

name.description:
The name field describes a name that is mapped to the shading language-specific name for describing
 per-vertex data. The appropriate shader language annex contains language-specific binding information.

X3DViewpointNode.description: A node of node type X3DViewpointNode defines a specific location in the local coordinate system from which the user may view the scene.

nearClippingPlane.description: Specifies the near clipping plane, alias for zNear

farClippingPlane.description: Specifies the far clipping plane, alias for zFar

viewAll.description:
When the viewAll field is set to TRUE or a viewpoint is bound with viewAll field TRUE,
the current view is modified to change the centerOfRotation field to match center of the bounding box for the entire visible scene,
and the orientation field is modified to aim at that point. Finally, the zoom position or fieldofview is adjusted to contain
the entire scene in the current viewing window. If needed, the near and far clipping planes shall be adjusted to allow viewing
the entire scene. When the value of the viewAll field is changed from TRUE to FALSE, no change in the current view occurs.

navigationInfo.description:
Defines a dedicated NavigationInfo node for this X3DViewpointNode. The specified NavigationInfo node receives
a set_bind TRUE event at the time when the parent node is bound and receives a set_bind FALSE at the time
when the parent node is unbound.

dimensions.description: Specifies the size of of the bounding box for the volume data.

voxels.description: The voxels field is an ImageTextureAtlas node containing the volume data.

allowViewpointInside.description: Allow to locate the viewpoint inside the volume.

enabled.description: Specifies whether the render style is enabled or disabled.
